gizmo.description: U muuji dhacdooyinka ku jira fayl jadwal sida kaarar taariikheed, taariikh-socod, shax ama liis.

configure.title: Faylka jadwalka
configure.description: Soo geli ama dooro fayl jadwal .ics ah. Dhacdooyinkiisa waxaa lagu akhriyaa biraawsarka.

configure.title: Ciwaan
